data.title: Binance Says User Funds Are ‘Completely Safe’ After $3.5 Billion Drains From Its Hot Wallets - Unchained
data.description: Binance says "user funds are completely safe" as Unchained's own count shows about $3.5 billion left wallets Etherscan labels as Binance's, on Ethereum alone.
data.author: Unchained
